visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white cat stands on a light-colored wooden floor inside a modern home. A young child with pigtails, wearing a brown uniform and a pink backpack, squats down to interact with the cat. The child holds out a small treat. The lighting is bright and natural, coming from large windows. (2) The camera zooms in to a close-up of the cat's face as it licks crumbs from the wooden floor. The child's hand is visible pointing at the crumbs. The background is slightly blurred, showing a table and chair legs. (3) A rapid montage sequence shows the cat sprinting and jumping across different rooms. It leaps over cardboard boxes, dashes past an indoor plastic slide and a white beanbag, and jumps onto a white desk scattered with office supplies. (4) The cat stands on a wooden desk next to a stained yellow pet bed. A hand enters the frame using a wet wipe to scrub the brown stain, followed by a spray bottle being used. The stain disappears. The cat is then shown lying peacefully on the cleaned yellow bed, looking directly at the camera with large green eyes. (5) A series of product shots features white spray bottles and packages of wet wipes labeled 'Lady Flavor'. A white cat and a calico cat appear in these scenes. A desk calendar with cat illustrations is shown being flipped. The background remains a bright, minimalist home studio.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, cheerful child's voice speaks over faint room tone. There is no music. Short pauses occur between phrases as the child interacts. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. A high-tempo electronic beat with synthesized percussion starts immediately. The tempo is approximately 128 BPM. (3) Continuous rapid 'whoosh' sounds and digital 'pops' align with fast visual cuts of the cat running. The BGM remains energetic. (4) Distinct spraying sound effects ('psht-psht') occur twice. A 'ding' chime sounds when a cleaning step is completed, accompanied by a 'sparkle' digital UI sound. (5) A clear, professional male voice begins narrating at a moderate pace, providing product details. The electronic BGM ducks slightly in volume to accommodate the narration but maintains its steady beat. (6) A final bright chime and a playful pop sound mark the end of the promotional segment, with the BGM fading out quickly.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a high-energy pet montage to show a common problem (pet mess) and then promotes 'Lady Flavor' cleaning products as the easy solution, concluding with a detailed promotional sale and call to action.
